terms.gloss: a wing (of a bird); also the wing of an army
evidence: Enn. ap. Cic. Div. 2.26: gallī plausū premunt ālās (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Of a building, Latin does not say āla in our sense (see wing, of a building).

terms.gloss: a feather; in the plural, wings
evidence: Plaut. Poen. 4.2.48: sine pennīs volāre haud facile est: meae ālae pennās nōn habent (Lewis & Short)

sources: Lewis & Short: ala
Lewis & Short: penna
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 407.
